description: 국토교통부_도시철도 노선별 경유역 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 도시철도 노선별 경유역 정보는 각 노선이 통과하는 역들의 세부 데이터를 포함하며, 주요 항목으로는 노선명, 역명, 역 ID, 역 순번, 노선별 정차역 등이 있습니다. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
